expected_value_creation: QIF review breadth increases because quality-gate packages can record canonical Quality Aspects as discovery lenses while verifier rules prevent aspect coverage from being treated as quality itself.
beneficiary: QIF users, maintainers, reviewers, and AI agents applying QIF to broad evaluation targets
supporting_evidence: Current quality-gate schema only supports evaluationPerspective enum values and lacks first-class aspect lenses.
User explicitly requested broader coverage across function, non-function, usability, performance, security, and UX design.
success_criteria: Quality Gate example validates with aspect-linked perspectives.
Verifier rejects unsupported aspects, aspect-as-quality interpretation, unused aspects, and broken aspect references.
Documentation states that aspect presence is not evidence or a verdict.
